children: CRITERIACAIXA HAS APPROVED AN INVESTMENT OF €250 MILLION IN THE SCALEUP EUROPE FUND (SEF), WHICH IS BEING LAUNCHED IN COLLABORATION WITH THE EUROPEAN COMMISSION AND OTHER EUROPEAN INSTITUTIONAL INVESTORS AND FOUNDATIONS
THE NEW FUND AIMS FOR AN INITIAL SIZE OF €5.00 BILLION TO PROMOTE THE GROWTH AND CONSOLIDATION OF EUROPEAN MID-SIZED COMPANIES, ESPECIALLY IN THE DEEPTECH SECTOR
THE INVESTMENT BY CRITERIACAIXA IS PART OF THE DEVELOPMENT OF ITS 2030 STRATEGIC PLAN, WITHIN THE ALTERNATIVE INVESTMENTS PORTFOLIO
